name: Administratively Reset TOTP
summary: Allows an authorized, recently step-up-authenticated administrator or support operator to invalidate another user's TOTP enrollment and recovery-code material without authenticating that target user.

requiredInputs.description: Durable identity whose TOTP enrollment is being reset.

guards.expression: actor has permission to reset another user's MFA

sourceReferences.note: ResetMfaAsync currently supplies the state-clearing primitive by delegating to the existing MFA disable operation.
The existing /api/auth/mfareset endpoint resets only the confirmed current user and therefore is not an administrative target-user boundary.
Administrative MFA reset is modeled as a privileged operation that does not authenticate the target user and requires fresh step-up proof for the actor.
